notes: The ASV renders יֹסְפִים … עוֹד once as any more; it is placed on עוֹד and the participle left unrepresented, since the two morphemes are too far apart for rule 30's contiguity condition. The reverse assignment is the competing reading.
this great fire writes one determiner, taken by the demonstrative, leaving all three articles unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
